On Mon, Oct 31, 2022 at 6:26 PM Sandra Luff < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Vera,
When do you depart? Would you have any availability (1-2 Nov) for a chat with Jacob Turowski, our head
of Public Policy for Central and Eastern Europe (biography below)?
If your schedule permits, we could provide you an update on Meta's regional workstreams, including our
actions in Ukraine. We'd be happy to host this meeting in-person at our Meta office or do a virtual or in-
person meeting at your office whatever works best for you.
Please let us know if there is a convenient time for you on the dates noted above and with whom we should
be in touch regarding logistics. I'm including Catherine Eng to help schedule on our side.
Best,
Sandy
Biography:
Jacob Turowski, Public Policy Director, Central and Eastern Europe
